contract.coordinates: All placement, walkBounds, spawn, exit and collision values are original world coordinates. build.py applies (coordinate-nativeBounds.origin)*worldScale exactly once.
contract.worldScale: Explicit positive ratio. Current CF7 male unarmed standing is 145.19 local pixels at 175cm; do not infer ratio solely from screen width. Use 1 while original reference ratio remains unverified, mark calibration pending.
contract.layers: PNG exported from independent background or isolated component only. Never scene.png/scene-preview/full composite. Preserve source reference and matrices in adjacent provenance metadata.
contract.depth: For runtime dynamic layers, use an explicit existing-safe fixed depth from DepthBands: far scenery behind units and foreground in occlusion band. Do not choose arbitrary 0 if occupied.
contract.elevator: A10 and A13 need an elevator-scroll layer: isolated native scroll tile PNG, positive loopHeight, clip:[x,y,width,height] relative to layer origin. Runtime repeats tile twice at 37 authored-frame positions. Exact A10/A13 composition remains distinct. Foreground window/cabin occluders must be separate foreground layers.
contract.collisions: Array of polygons; each polygon has at least 3 [x,y] points. Original collision evidence or explicit prototype adjustment provenance required.
